name: Bots: core
description: Bot framework core: bots are stock Player objects without a client on their own banned accounts. Phase 3a-3c: bot accounts and characters with personas (names, looks, traits, play times), login/logout into the world, restore after a restart, bot presence for hooks P3-BOT-*, the bot runtime (shards, mailboxes, LOD) and the brain API (service org.l2start.bots.api.BrainRegistry), //bots admin commands. Phase 3e: the presence director: bots appear only around real players, out of their sight, with level, class, skills and gear of the zone, and leave unseen.

RequireGeodata.description: Bots enter the world only where geodata is loaded (GeoEngine.hasGeo).

MaxBots.description: Upper limit of bot characters that //bots create may make.

MaxInWorld.description: Upper limit of bots in the world at the same time.

AutoCreate.description: On server start, create bots until at least this many exist (0 = only //bots create).

AutoSpawn.description: On server start, log this many bots into the world (0 = only //bots spawn).

DeathReturnMin.description: A dead bot waits at least this long before it returns to the nearest town.

RestoreOnStart.description: Bots that were in the world when the server stopped come back on start, at the same places.

NameStyles.description: Share of nickname styles (word lists: data/names/*.txt).

Timezones.description: Time zones of bot personas (Moscow +-2 hours, approved). Used by the session planner (step 3e).

Chronotypes.description: When personas usually play. Used by the session planner (step 3e).

Seed.description: Random seed for new personas (0 = random). Fixed seeds are for tests.

Brain.description: Id of the brain every bot gets (a module registers it through the BrainRegistry service; bots-brain-basic registers 'basic'). No such brain = bots stand idle.

Shards.description: Tick shards (0 = max(2, cores/4)). A bot belongs to shard botId % N.

WaveMs.description: Every shard ticks its due bots this often.

WaveBudgetMs.description: Time budget of one wave; bots that do not fit wait for the next wave (counted as overrun).

ViewRadius.description: What a bot sees (monsters, players, drops) around itself.

PromoteRadius.description: A live player this close makes a bot ACTIVE (ticks 0.3-1 s instead of 3-5 s).

DemoteRadius.description: An ACTIVE bot goes back to PRESENT when no live player is this close ...

Presence.description: director = bots exist only around real players (presence director, step 3e; no restore/autospawn); manual = //bots spawn, AutoSpawn and restore as in 3a-3d.

DirectorTickMs.description: The director looks at players and bots this often.

DirectorMaxInWorld.description: Global budget: director bots in the world at the same time (MaxInWorld still applies).

DirectorMaxPerCluster.description: At most this many bots around one group of players (town + hunting grounds).

DirectorHuntPerCluster.description: Hunting bots around a group of players: base, plus this many per extra player.

DirectorTownNight.description: Bots in a town with a player in it at night (min,max).

DirectorGround.description: Bots on one hunting ground (min,max; by its size; indoor grounds get half).

DirectorHidden.description: Bots appear this far from every player (min,max) and run in.

DirectorUnseenRadius.description: No player within this distance = the bot is unseen.

DirectorUnseenLogout.description: An unseen bot logs out after this long.

DirectorLinger.description: A bot that a player has seen this long (min,max by persona) goes away.

DirectorReturnCooldown.description: A persona that logged out is not brought back sooner.

OnlineCurve.description: 24 values 0..1 by server hour: 0 = night minimum, 0.5 = day, 1 = evening peak (town density, ground density).

Anchors.description: Test players for the director: x;y;z points treated as live players (smoke, load tests). Empty in real use.

StatsLogInterval.description: Runtime line 'BOTS world=... p99=... overrun=...' in the log this often while bots are in the world (0 = never).
